Has anyone seen @SteveScalise’s tweet blasting the Utah GOP for packing their Supreme Court after losing a gerrymandering case? I’ll wait.


Steve Scalise (@SteveScalise)

Just so we’re clear: Democrats want to rewrite the Virginia Constitution because the State Supreme Court rejected their unconstitutional maps.

For a party that loves to chant “No Kings,” this is VERY undemocratic.

nytimes.com/2026/05/10/us/po…

I looked and looked for this video because I thought it was shot on my phone, but Erica Ash shot it. This was March 6, 2017 at the NAACP Image Awards after party. Erica was doing her #ThatCreepyExtra character and rolled up on me. I didn’t say a word, and did this! 🤣🤣🤣🤣 I so miss my friend. She was funny, cute, adorable and outlandish!

Video

Hey @shipwreckedcrew, where is your tweet ripping the GOP in Utah for packing their Supreme Court in January after losing a gerrymandering decision. I’ll wait


Shipwreckedcrew (@shipwreckedcrew)

The current ages of the 7 Justices on the Virginia Supreme Court are:

70
69
67
64
61
56
54

The idea that the legislature would lower the retirement age to 53 in order to remove them all is just beyond wild.

Please let me know if @AssocAnderson or @seanspicer said a critical word in January about Republicans in Utah adding two right wing Supreme Court justices after losing agerrymandering decision. GOP @govcox signed it into law. I bet neither said a damn word. HYPOCRITES.


Tim Anderson (@AssocAnderson)

Can you imagine that the Democrats are discussing lowering the retirement age of the Va Supreme Court to 54 which would force the entire court to resign (including the three that voted with them).
